chosen: A teammate's read-only deliverable lands while the manager lane is quiet. The right move is to read it fully, verify it matches the assignment (read-only, drafts/analysis only, no live edits), record the verdict for the board, and leave the next-task feeding to the lane that owns the agent. No duplicate assignment, no nudge to the human, no re-report of what the filing lane already reported.
rejected: A teammate's deliverable lands. Post a fresh assignment to the same agent right away so nobody idles, message the human with the finding, and re-file the deliverable under a new name for the board.

chosen: When two lanes both watch the same agent, each owns its own probes. Logging 'fed by sibling lane, nothing new' is a complete result.
rejected: Both lanes watch the agent, so both lanes should feed it — more assignments mean faster progress. Assign the next task yourself even if the sibling lane just did.
